01-word-processing-basics.md.title: Word Processing Basics
01-word-processing-basics.md.description: Module 03 — CCC Exam Preparation | Topic 1 --- Word processing means using a computer to create, edit, format, save, and print text documents. A word processor is the software that lets you do this. The most popular word processor in the world is Microsoft Word (commonly called MS Word). It is part of the Microsoft Office suite. Other word processors include LibreOffice Writer, Google Docs, and WordPad, but the CCC exam focuses almost entirely...

02-text-creation-editing.md.title: Text Creation and Editing
02-text-creation-editing.md.description: Module 03 — CCC Exam Preparation | Topic 2 --- When you open MS Word, a blank document appears automatically. You can also create new documents at any time: The blinking vertical line you see is called the cursor (or insertion point). Whatever you type will appear at the cursor position. --- Simply start typing to enter text into your document. 03-text-formatting.md.title: Text Formatting
03-text-formatting.md.description: Module 03 — CCC Exam Preparation | Topic 3 --- Formatting means changing the appearance of text to make it look better, easier to read, or more professional. Formatting does not change the content of the text — only how it looks. In MS Word, most formatting options are found on the Home tab in the ribbon. --- Font formatting changes the appearance of individual characters (letters, numbers, symbols). 04-paragraph-formatting.md.title: Paragraph Formatting and Document Features
04-paragraph-formatting.md.description: Module 03 — CCC Exam Preparation | Topic 4 --- Indenting means adding extra space between the margin and the text of a paragraph. Indenting helps organize text and makes documents look professional. 05-tables-in-word.md.title: Tables in MS Word
05-tables-in-word.md.description: Module 03 — CCC Exam Preparation | Topic 5 --- A table is a grid of rows and columns used to organize data in a structured format. Each box in the table is called a cell. Tables are one of the most important features in MS Word and are heavily tested in the CCC exam.
